neighbours.label: the final piece 'ai' (and similar endings) of non-English proper names: Maathai, Eisai, Mathai
fire: The novelist Arundhati Roy once interviewed the economist Thomas Isaac Mathai about land reform.
Shares of Eisai rose after the Alzheimer's drug was approved.
Wangari Maathai planted millions of trees across Kenya.
The report was co-written by Dr. Suresh Kumar and Dr. Anil Mathai.
In 2015 the dementia drug was developed jointly by Biogen and Eisai.
The Green Belt Movement was founded by Professor Maathai in 1977.
Our new neighbour, Mr. Varghese Mathai, teaches chemistry at the college.
Researchers at Eisai published the trial results in a medical journal.
quiet: The novelist Arundhati Roy once interviewed the economist Thomas Piketty about land reform.

Activists planted millions of trees across Kenya.

notes: card: 'ai' x4, 'on' x6, 'i', 'ari' in names (Mathai, Eisai, Maathai, Aquarimax). Probe: Maathai 0.77, Eisai 0.92, Mathai 0.89, Pfizer 0.00. Test new names ending in a split 'ai'.
